name: 最近開いた資料のまとまり
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Redesign ONE actual Lighthouse component LH15-0006, recently opened document group, with four existing rows. Pure white canvas, no app chrome/device.
Reference hierarchy: Image1 ORIGINAL controls file-type glyph geometry, proportions, optical weight, spacing and three-dot controls. Use original's first four file rows: green spreadsheet symbol, blue lined document symbol, green spreadsheet symbol, red PDF filetype artwork. Preserve these recognizable original artwork colors and fine shapes. Image2 OUR MOCK is secondary authority for the selected four rows and exact Japanese wording; its repeated generic green blank-file vectors are rough substitutes to replace. Do not add the original page's other file rows or navigation. Image3 approved bus supplies only white rounded surface/fine border/soft-shadow craft.
Text verbatim:
small section label "資料"
row1 title "奉仕計画の一覧"; metadata "よく開いている資料"
row2 title "地域訪問の行程"; metadata "開いた日 · 11月11日"
row3 title "連絡先の確認表"; metadata "開いた日 · 8月25日"
row4 title "配布用の資料"; metadata "作成日 · 10月14日"
Each row has its type icon at left, title and metadata two lines, three horizontal overflow dots right. Exactly four rows, four overflow controls. Keep full copy untruncated, titles not bold or enlarged. Meiryo Regular14/24px title and Regular12/16px metadata/section label; tracking0. Logical width390px. Preserve calm compact64px row rhythm with restrained group spacing.
Materials: one rounded white surface, very subtle neutral edge and soft downward shadow on #FFFFFF; no separate card wrapping for every row. Ink#1D1D1D, supporting copy#6E6E6E, overflow dots#526173. White ordinary surfaces, no mint panels or colored decorative chips.
Accent decision: Source colors green/blue/red distinguish genuine file types and are original icon artwork. Retain their consistent mapping (sheets rows1/3, document row2, PDF row4), no random per-row decorative color. No selection/CTA/metric exists, so invent none, no extra green button or gradient. Original details override rough mock.
No extra labels, dates, rows, controls, captions, IDs, watermark, source English copy. Original PDF letters are part of file-type artwork. Static candidate only.
reviewNotes: 原図と自作を実際に開いて比較。原図の資料形式の区別を復元：緑の表1・3、青の文書2、赤のPDF4。自作の一律の緑の白紙より原図の図形細部を優先。生成を目視：資料、4件の日本語題名と更新情報、4個の三点を保持、余計な項目なし。白面・中立枠・柔らかい影。厳密なMeiryoメトリクス・中点幅・所有者承認・編集性・実装未証明。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
